population: All10606 usable original train row groups, rows99..19999, no validation targets. This is only the train component of train+valid parent training; H2 uses valid only and is not audited here.
eligibility: Exactly parent valid=step>=99; train cache mask must be allFalse and is ignored, matching mask_weight=False. No event, class, magnitude or selected-score eligibility filter.
event: float32 D=t0-t1; changed[t]=(D[t]!=D[t-1]) for t>=1; next change strictly after current row, sentinel20000; same next_change_labels semantics.
censoring: Right-censored when no strictly later D change is observed before row19999. Report eventful-sequence terminal tails separately from entirely no-change sequences. Last row has no positive time bound and is excluded from informative-censor coverage.
lower_bound: D_next>19999-t; transformed bound(log1p(19999-t)-3)/2. Trainer sentinel log1p(20000-t) is not an observed duration. No time clipping/max exists in this trainer; clamp(max=19999) applies only to gather indices for unavailable sign labels.
quiet: target_quiet means retrospective age>=64 since last target-contrast change, with origin0. It is NOT causal input i0-quiet and is never a serving feature.
weights: Report row counts and sum over both targets of abs(clip(y,-2,2)). This is target-mass coverage, NOT official train score or exact parent aux/main loss-weight coverage. Actual propensity²+.03 and raw-i0 since weights unavailable here.
since_bound: Descriptive hypothetical reweighting of that target mass by any a in[.25,1]: C/(C+4O) <= fraction <= 4C/(4C+O). These are not bounds on actual parent loss weights because propensity is omitted.
chain_halves: sha256('TARGET_CENSOR_COVERAGE01|half|'+str(chain_id)) mod2; all row groups of a chain remain together. No fitting or scoring split.

one_fixed_gate.statistic: Hypothetical since-factor upper bound on informative eventful right-tail clipped-target-mass fraction over all eligible train rows, separately in both deterministic chain halves
one_fixed_gate.pass_meaning: POTENTIALLY_MATERIAL_TARGET_CENSORING; source design may continue, no forecast fit automatically authorized
one_fixed_gate.fail_meaning: STOP_LOW_TARGET_COVERAGE for this train-only child; no horizon, class, threshold or loss rescue
one_fixed_gate.limitation: Allocation heuristic, not proof of absence/presence of useful supervision, and not a train+valid/H2 conclusion. No-event sequences are separately described and cannot rescue the gate.

cached_auxiliary_predictions: Not present in this branch's frozen input set. Do not generate predictions or discover/select an alternate cache; lower-bound violations unavailable.
